description: Read each connected Shopify store's sync configuration: the store-level data-flow switches (pullInventory, pushInventory, pushSalesOrders, rebalanceInventoryOnStoreTransfer), pickupExcludedOrderTags (Shopify order tags that keep an order off the pickup queue), the payment-status → Spark-status import mapping including fulfilledImportStatus, and the per-location warehouse mappings with their inventory sync modes. Inventory flows per location require BOTH the store switch and the location mode to allow the direction. Returns an empty list until Shopify is connected and store setup has run. Existing array shape is preserved. Without limit, at most 100 stores are returned or PAGING_REQUIRED is raised. For explicit limit/offset pages, advance offset by limit until a short page. Nested locations are capped at 1000 per response; select shopifyStoreUrl and use locationLimit/locationOffset to page one store's locations the same way. Set includeLocations=false to discover store domains without loading nested locations. Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

includeLocations.description: Include nested locations (default true). Set false for store-domain discovery.

limit.description: Explicit store page size (1–100). Omit for a complete list up to 100 rows.

locationLimit.description: Explicit location page size (1–100); requires shopifyStoreUrl.

offset.description: Zero-based store offset; requires limit when nonzero.

shopifyStoreUrl.description: Optional store domain to read, matched case-insensitively.

name: get_shopify_store_settings
title: Shopify Store Settings
